{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the sales data
sales_df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv')

# Convert revenue from string to float
sales_df['revenue'] = sales_df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Filter for customers who converted (converted == 1)
converted_customers = sales_df[sales_df['converted'] == 1]

# Filter out invalid age (-1)
valid_converted = converted_customers[converted_customers['customer_age'] != -1]

# Compute mean age of those who converted and have valid age
mean_age_converted = valid_converted['customer_age'].mean()

# Verify the count of valid converted customers
valid_count = len(valid_converted)

# Print result
print(f"Mean age of customers who converted (valid age only): {mean_age_converted}")
print(f"Number of valid converted customers: {valid_count}")"}
